title: After the lead changes elsewhere, the work order moves group on refresh
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A work order visible in Tech View.
custom_steps:
1. Note a work order under technician A in Tech View.
  2. Change its lead to technician B from the work order detail page.
  3. Refresh Tech View.
  4. Confirm the work order now appears under technician B.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • After the lead is changed somewhere else, the work order moves to its new technician group on the next refresh.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10045 — Story 2 Tech View.
